tools.name: replayfix_reproduce
tools.description: Ingests bug video/recording or task ID, executes Gate 1 in an isolated scratch sandbox, and returns verified RED failure telemetry and DOM ariaSnapshot.

tools.name: replayfix_verify_patch
tools.description: Applies a candidate unified diff patch to an ephemeral scratch sandbox, executes Gate 2 stability pass (and optional Gate 3 stress quorum), and returns a cryptographically signed RFC 6962 Merkle receipt.

tools.name: replayfix_inoculate
tools.description: Synthesizes a permanent, self-healing Playwright regression test (tests/repro/rf_<id>.spec.ts) with semantic accessibility locators and updates .replayfix/inoculations.json.

tools.name: replayfix_inspect_trace
tools.description: Queries DOM candidates, action trajectory timestamps, keyframe paths, and ASR spoken audio transcripts for a task.

tools.name: replayfix_doctor
tools.description: Returns host toolchain health and environment diagnostics (Git, Node.js, Playwright, FFmpeg).

prompts.name: triage_bug
prompts.description: Guides an external LLM through visual bug analysis, causal attribution, and surgical patch generation.
